t: Magnusson extra-fine 1200 grit hand sanding sheets are designed for high-quality finishing on wood and metal surfaces. Ideal for professional decorators and automotive restorers, the pack of 4 sheets provides an exceptionally smooth finish. Constructed from sharp silicon carbide abrasive on water-resistant B-weight latex paper, the sheets perform exceptionally well for both wet and dry applications. The robust backing prevents tearing, ensuring durability and consistent performance during detailed preparation work. Measuring 280mm by 230mm, they provide generous coverage for efficient material removal, and deliver a high-quality, professional finish.
b: Large Sheets Ensure Wide Coverage for Fast Material Removal
